title: Xcode Canvas recovery
current_focus: Native Refresh Canvas button now exercised under existing preview probes: no selected update/helper callbacks in the bounded manual interval. Real source edits/restoration each produce 18 paired nested calls in both sessions. Manual refresh internals/render completion remain unknown.

milestones.title: Fully reverse engineer native Xcode Canvas first
milestones.note: The closed issue establishes the research toolkit and scoped boundary oracles. It does not close a full Canvas recovery area.

milestones.title: Standalone cross-platform WASM Canvas
milestones.note: Standalone implementation depends on full native recovery. Existing prototypes are preparatory.

recovery.scope: Complete native behavior across the declared version/project/target matrix. This is a closure metric, not an estimate of all code or behavior discovered.
requirements: Pinned source entry points and transitions
Actual positive-change and relevant failure controls
Explicit input/output/ordering contract with complete comparison
Reproducible replay or retained observation procedure

areas.title: Canvas UI
areas.verified_summary: Owned PreviewLab pin toggle/restore and new-window/close sequence exercised once. Added-window disappearance observed; original window preserved. Native weak receiver samples remain positive after close.
areas.remaining: Complete control/menu/shortcut inventory and enabled-state transitions.

areas.title: Project binding
areas.verified_summary: Scheme buildable selection, builder population, reuse and invalidation routes recovered. Native project/scheme/destination context observed separately.
areas.remaining: Actual target/source/settings/dependency/resource ownership across projects and destinations.

areas.title: Discovery & variants
areas.verified_summary: Selected plain registry/body and explicit provider controls on pinned profiles.
areas.remaining: General declaration discovery, traits, variants and selection identity across edits.

areas.title: Build & refresh
areas.evidence_level: Native selection, scene-method and false build-stop gate execution
areas.verified_summary: Real build/file controls exercised positive/negative selection and scene-update calls. Six build-stop handlers observed false auto-resume input and returned before scene/state checks. True gate, asynchronous completion and rendering remain open.
areas.remaining: Correlated native build/update/cancel/failure/retry and persistent state transitions.

areas.title: Sessions & transport
areas.verified_summary: Native connection/reply/codec controls with explicit lifetime and failure boundaries.
areas.remaining: A complete correlated Canvas/agent/host lifecycle and routing/error matrix.

areas.title: Rendering
areas.evidence_level: Native UI rendered edit/restore observation; full renderer contract open
areas.verified_summary: Native selected preview visibly changed purple to brown after source edit and restored; screenshot-region repeat passed without active hooks. This is not render-buffer equality, all view semantics or standalone WASM parity.
areas.remaining: All rendering routes, device environments and output publication/completion ordering.

areas.title: Interaction & state
areas.evidence_level: Native update selected path + rendered color edit; interactive state untested
areas.verified_summary: Preview.update and instance-assignment helper entry/return observed during actual file color edit. Native output changed and restored. Item identity, state/input, focus, accessibility and lifecycle continuity remain unqualified.
areas.remaining: Input, focus, accessibility, identity, observation, tasks, animation and refresh-state semantics.

areas.title: Resource lifetime
areas.evidence_level: Native observer and failure-action lifetimes; full resource settlement open
areas.verified_summary: Unfulfilled release invoked captured failure action on releasing thread. Fulfillment cleared observer context but retained action context until owner destruction. Owned weak contexts/FDs checked; arbitrary captures and transport/render settlement remain open.
areas.remaining: Owner/cleanup graphs across success, failure, cancellation, reuse, refresh and peer loss.

areas.title: Target differences
areas.verified_summary: Requested device families are recorded; no all-target acceptance claimed.
areas.remaining: Versioned native comparisons for every claimed Apple profile and real non-Apple host validation.

recent.title: Native manual refresh differs from selected file-update probes
recent.detail: Ambiguous menu route failed; switched to observed paused-Canvas Refresh button. AXPress succeeds and original headers return, but selected private callbacks stay zero during bounded manual interval. Real file edit/restore gives 18 paired updates/helpers per phase in each of two sessions. No pixel/resource or full manual-refresh proof.

recent.title: Project close/reopen exercised; target destruction still unknown
recent.detail: One native run: 24 matched setters; old receiver weak-loadable after Close Project and reopen, then a second token observed. No destructor entries/returns. Probe cleanup confirmed. Reopened Canvas paused; one post-collector Refresh restores original pin/header controls. This is UI observation, not new build/render/resource completion.

recent.title: Native window closes; sampled Canvas receivers remain live
recent.detail: GUI recovered through bounded native activation. Pin toggle/new window/close sequence passes once: 43 matched setters, two weak-loadable receivers after window disappearance and again 3.16s later. No target destructor observed. Earlier incomplete window and idle project-close preparation retained; no leak/resource-release claim.

recent.title: Caller reference released during native SDK callbacks
recent.detail: Five SDK modes pass twice, including dictionary/error callbacks held across explicit client-reference release. Release returns with capture/FD live; later deinit/close observed. Connection deallocation is not inferred. Eight owner faults and historical SDK faults reject; no new native failure.

recent.title: Native SDK in-flight replies and capture cleanup tested
recent.detail: Three owned libxpc modes pass twice: normal, cancel during callback, cancel before reply. Active reply/capture stays live until callback completion; pending cancel delivers an invalid reply. Two earlier identity-guard aborts preserved; unsupported PID query now recorded. Eight semantic faults reject.

recent.title: Actual native tuple paths matched; membership control exercised
recent.detail: Guarded getters identify primary edit/delete and auxiliary membership-removal inputs. Auxiliary remains on disk but its removed tuple has no type/zero candidates. Three other handler invocations complete coalescer→scene-update requests; no rendered/removal completion claim. Eight path faults reject.

recent.title: Typed edit controls isolate deletion loss before predicate
recent.detail: Two native runs: edits/restoration carry a present type and one candidate, reaching thunkable=true/predicate=false. Deletion carries one input with absent optional type and zero candidates; no predicate call. Source restored, eight input faults reject. No full removal/resource acceptance.

recent.title: Native zero-count gate observed in actual deletion cases
recent.detail: Two changed-probe captures measure count zero after filter return; one also reaches empty cleanup. Count-only variant agrees. Both exit nonzero for missing scene propagation after restoring source. Filter exclusion reason and resource release remain unknown; eight gate faults reject.

recent.title: Actual file deletions stop before selected scene propagation
recent.detail: Primary deletion and a distinct compiled auxiliary-member deletion each correlate with native removed-block/filter intervals. No workspace/editor removal or scene update in those invocations. Both waits false; exact source/project bytes restored. Eight evidence faults reject; stopping reason remains unknown.

recent.title: Native late callbacks overlap; repeated invalidate is not a join
recent.detail: Two native runs execute sixteen controls. Late registration invokes synchronously on a second thread while the original callback blocks; its context/FD cleans up first. Original cleanup follows unblock/join. First reader coverage failure retained and corrected; eight synthetic faults reject.

recent.title: Actual native weak loads exercised; target destruction still open
recent.detail: Two real source cycles each record 25 paired setter calls and two positive main-queue weak snapshots. Probe weak slots destroyed; no helper loaded into Xcode. Three owned ABI/FD modes reproduce. No native deinitializer/nil sample or UI closure test; eight synthetic evidence faults reject.

recent.title: Weak-loader boundary recorded; native file route still works
recent.detail: Owned weak/FD fixture modes pass. Xcode rejects helper Team ID and Mac lock blocks UI controls; no bypass attempted. Two real source-edit captures record 20/22 guarded setter intervals, no selected destructor calls. Address ledger does not establish native weak lifetime; eight artifact faults reject.

recent.title: Probe boundary corrected; bounded native flow observed
recent.detail: State cleanup point is interior to CanvasContent destruction. Prior caller/return interpretation was invalid. Two captures recorded 28/22 sampled owner→PC→return chains. Tail-site scope/logging failed and was excluded; fixed profile uses finite samples and posted phase acknowledgements. Original sealed evidence preserved with erratum.

recent.title: Native preview declaration lifecycle and recovered call ordering
recent.detail: Real 3→4→3 tabs and orange→fallback-purple output repeated without active hooks. Twelve collectors each called two providers then two registries. Content witness returned 1,400 times; state entry recorded but return coverage unavailable. Zero removed-location calls. Eight artifact mutations reject. Correction: the state probe was an interior PC, not a separate function; see latest boundary evidence.

recent.title: Owned context destructor reentry during invalidation passes
recent.detail: Same live handle nested invalidation returned; destructor-created late observer ran synchronously without token. Two native runs, fifteen normal controls each; six synthetic mutations reject. Per-context FD checks account for number reuse. Apple Canvas destructor/resource coverage remains open.

recent.title: App input and Canvas state separated experimentally
recent.detail: Actual app AX Increment changed 0→1 while selected Xcode Canvas still showed 0. Same observed owned app PID before/after; source unchanged. This working app route cannot qualify Canvas input. Five artifact mutations reject; similarity gate failure retained without parity claim.

recent.title: Executing observer destroys its own token
recent.detail: Two actual native runs pass thirteen controls each, including token drop with/without repeated cancellation. Context/owned FD cleanup bounded by callback marker and invalidate return. Run1 reader omitted new controls initially; final reader checks both runs and runner now enforces mode coverage. Six synthetic mutations reject.

recent.title: Native title refresh passes; state input unresolved
recent.detail: Actual title edit/restoration visibly rendered. Two Increment attempts left Count: 0; no successful input delivery or state preservation claimed. Wrong-scale editor click and overstrict pixel checks preserved. Four artifact mutations rejected; source restored and Xcode left alive.

recent.title: Native Preview.update and rendered color change exercised
recent.detail: Fresh background Xcode session exposed Canvas. Real source edit entered Preview.update and selected assignment helper eighteen times each, changed native color, and restored. Same-process repeat had no active hooks; interactive state remains untested.

recent.title: Native failure-action callback and retained captures reproduced
recent.detail: Main and worker controls: unfulfilled owner release invoked action synchronously; fulfilled release skipped action yet retained capture until destruction. Observer/context and FD cleanup checked. No native crashes/timeouts.

recent.title: Native log delivery and observer effects distinguished
recent.detail: Real Swift-string log inputs returned and produced readable native backend records without hooks. Gate-only controls also logged correctly. Attached probes observed the API call but stored compose failures. Earlier unqualified input remains excluded.

recent.title: Native owner-release policy outcomes reproduced
recent.detail: Debug-only and soft-assert configurations returned; fatal unfulfilled release trapped. Fulfilled controls returned for all three. Owned cleanup checked in returning controls. Log attempt segfaulted with unqualified payload and is excluded from policy claims.

recent.title: Observer dispatch cancellation and nested registration reproduced
recent.detail: Two runs of eleven native controls passed. Later callback survived cancellation after dispatch began; nested late observer ran before add returned and remaining observers. Owned weak contexts/FDs cleared; no transport/resource parity claim.

recent.title: Native false auto-resume path exercised
recent.detail: Two qualified success/failure/recovery runs: six stop handlers read false preference input and returned before scene/state/refresh. Incomplete probe capture preserved; true preference and rendered resume remain unverified.

recent.title: Native passing-file route reached scene update
recent.detail: Two runs/four file-change invocations: open/thunkable=false, should-update=true, coalescer and scene-update method executed. Caller offsets matched recovered route. Added file was unreferenced by preview; rendered completion remains unverified.

recent.title: Real source edits exercised native time and filter gates
recent.detail: Two runs: early edit reached suppressed cleanup; delayed edit and restoration reached filter. Native predicates returned open/thunkable=true and should-update=false in reproduction. Exact two-second boundary and rendered refresh remain unverified.

recent.title: Native build listeners exercised through six real builds
recent.detail: Two success/failure/recovery sequences passed. Each start classified as non-preview; stop result reads were 1/2/1. Agent-marked reproduction and four trace-assertion failure controls passed. Full refresh/rendering remains unverified.

recent.title: In-flight cancellation and concurrent native controls passed
recent.detail: Cancel returned while callback/context/FD stayed alive; callback completion released them. 100 four-operation concurrent rounds had zero duplicate callbacks and complete owned cleanup. These samples do not prove race freedom.

recent.title: Native runtime controls executed; static expansion paused
recent.detail: Six normal native controls passed and reproduced. Destructor reentry produced a recursive-lock termination. Real Xcode file edit, rendered text change, syntax error and recovery observed. Internal build notifications remain untraced.

recent.title: Five fulfillment failure-policy routes recovered
recent.detail: Source separates test callback, logging, pinned-image debug-only logging, softAssert delegate and fatal assertion. Fresh replay passes; effective diagnostics, assertion delivery and process behavior remain unobserved.

recent.title: Token destruction and softAssert policy decoded
recent.detail: Source delegates callback destruction then releases once guarantee. Full enum-tag decoding binds constructor to softAssert. Fresh replay passes; actual deinit, assertion and cancellation effects remain unobserved.

recent.title: Observer registration and weak cancellation tokens recovered
recent.detail: Waiting registration stores observer and returns weak-owner token. Late registration invokes observer after unlock and returns no token. Cancel uses one-shot gate. Fresh replay passes; actual delivery and lifetime effects remain unverified.

recent.title: Observer-token detachment and cleanup ordering recovered
recent.detail: Source removes by identifier only while waiting. Removed observer context release precedes unlock; acquired owner/result cleanup follows. Fresh replay passes; actual cancel, last-owner deinit and reentry remain unobserved.

recent.title: One-shot invalidation storage transfer recovered
recent.detail: Source waiting path transfers observer/token storage and marks fulfilled. Already-fulfilled normal return yields empty storage; managed-token outcome 1 suppresses callback. Fresh replay passes; actual repeats and failure effects remain unverified.

recent.title: Invalidation dispatch separated from state deinit diagnostics
recent.detail: Source binds concrete handle state, waiting/fulfilled deinit gates and explicit invalidate lock boundaries. Observer/token callbacks follow unlock. Fresh replay passes; helper transitions and actual cancellation remain unproven.

recent.title: Execution-status payload cleanup recovered
recent.detail: Source binds running to optional stale output, valid to an inline-cleaned update, and failed to optional stale output plus Error. Three logical dispatch routes and fresh replay pass; dynamic destruction and actual cancellation remain unproven.

recent.title: Execution update and invalidation-handle ownership recovered
recent.detail: Source links update cleanup to ConcurrentInvalidationHandle release and erased-point cleanup to generic box ownership. Handle deinit releases name/state references; actual cancellation and resource settlement remain unproven. Fresh replay passes.

recent.title: Preview-state cleanup and variant-array release recovered
recent.detail: Source verifies all live/static state cleanup dispatches, failure-reason release, viewable payload cleanup and final groups-array reference release. Fresh replay passes; dynamic witness contents and actual resource settlement remain open.

recent.title: Canvas payload and mode destruction dependencies recovered
recent.detail: Source binds registry execution status to ExecutionPointStatus<AnyExecutionPoint> and preview live/grid payload cleanup to native types. Fresh replay and scoped dependency graph pass; actual cancellation and settlement remain open.

recent.title: Outer setter delegation and relay-release boundary recovered
recent.detail: Source setters delegate typed assignment. Preview destruction destroys item, releases settingsRelay, then inspects optional canvas content. Fresh replay passes; actual deinit and final resource settlement remain unverified.

recent.title: Registry identity matching and preview retention recovered
recent.detail: Source updates matched definitions and retains present previews even when registryInstance is absent; missing preview stays missing. Fresh replay passes; runtime identity and resource settlement remain unverified.

recent.title: Preview item and canvas-instance synchronization recovered
recent.detail: Source assigns item first and updates only existing preview canvas content; missing/registry content skips instance synchronization. Cross-framework setter replay passes; actual state/render/resource continuity remains open.

recent.title: Provider identity matching and source refresh recovered
recent.detail: Source matches providers by source ID, constructs misses and updates matched values. Provider-instance previews receive new source through Preview.update. Fresh replay passes; runtime identity and cleanup remain open.

recent.title: Previewables priority and collector publication recovered
recent.detail: Pinned source ID is submitted first. Collector assembles pinned/open provider and registry lists, applies visibility/source ordering, then publishes observable content. Fresh source replay passes; row reconciliation and resource cleanup remain open.

recent.title: Pinning-state comparison and notification ordering recovered
recent.detail: Equal optional preview descriptions skip callback. Changes request previewsChanged, emit pinnedFileDidChange and call previewablesDidChange. Fresh static replay passes; downstream effects and native completion remain open.

recent.title: Removed-location scene propagation and pin cleanup recovered
recent.detail: Source forwards to editor scenes, compares associated locations and clears matching pin/file sources through a setter. Fresh replay passes; downstream notifications and resource settlement remain open.

recent.title: Removed-file dispatch and update ordering recovered
recent.detail: Source separates removed-location submission from cache invalidation and refresh. Fresh replay passes. Native UI observation returned no tree with locked-screen/permission diagnostic; actual resource disposal remains open.

recent.title: Build-stop state gate and refresh request recovered
recent.detail: Native source gates automatic refresh on preference, result flag, scene and blocked/paused state. Running/empty return. Fresh static replay passes; actual resume/render/state remains unverified.

recent.title: Native build notification classification recovered
recent.detail: Start flag traced to isPreviewsBuild (buildCommand == 8); stop flag is result == 1 without an established enum name. Fresh static replay passes; native event timing remains open.

recent.title: Build timestamp and file-event time gate recovered
recent.detail: Static source qualifies a two-second suppression comparison after the build-start timestamp. Exact boundary and missing-timestamp paths checked; actual timing and payload flag meaning remain unobserved.

recent.title: Thunkable-file membership recovered
recent.detail: Static source qualifies scene source-identifier/URL membership and late external-change refresh gates. Actual event delivery remains unobserved.

recent.title: Modified-file selection policy recovered
recent.detail: Typed-file filtering and bundle/package/path exclusions reproduced by a fresh static reader.

recent.detail: Settings/scheme/destination/package/platform events map to coalescer scheduling and cached-builder invalidation in source.

recent.detail: Selection → cached buildables → dependency request connected in source; runtime execution remains unqualified.

history.note: Initial audited status baseline; no inferred historical percentages.

overall.formula: Closed issues across milestones 1 and 2 / all issues in those milestones
overall.completion_gate: 100% additionally requires all nine recovery areas accepted and explicit Linux, macOS, Windows, standalone WASM SwiftUI runtime and full product conformance evidence.

runtime_validation.summary: Two native sessions contrast bounded idle/manual intervals with real file writes: zero selected manual callbacks; edit and restore each produce 18 paired updates with nested selected assignment helpers.
runtime_validation.ui_summary: Menu executor failed on ambiguous Canvas path; not retried. Paused owned Canvas AXButton press succeeds and original header/pin UI returns. Source/project restored, hooks detached, Xcode alive and controller available.
runtime_validation.unknown: Manual refresh internal route, asynchronous completion, state continuity, pixel rendering, new build notifications and target/resource release remain unverified. File-phase callbacks do not establish manual parity; zero is bounded to two selected probes.
runtime_validation.normal_native_count_scope: Observer suite only; policy, build and file controls are reported separately.
